scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: The operator of a vehicle, meaning a person who drives or has physical control of the vehicle (Texas Transportation Code uses 'operator').
To overtake and move past another vehicle going in the same direction, then return to an authorized lane of travel.
The vehicle going in the same direction that the PASSER is moving past.
The portion of a highway, other than the berm or shoulder, that is improved, designed, or ordinarily used for vehicular travel.
The lanes of the ROADWAY intended for through vehicle travel, excluding shoulders.
A paved shoulder next to the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION of a highway.
A section of highway designated by signs or pavement markings where passing or driving on the left side of the ROADWAY is prohibited.
The common area where two or more highways join or cross, within the lateral boundary lines of the ROADWAYs.
An incorporated city, town, or village.
The part of a ROADWAY at an INTERSECTION within the prolongation of the sidewalk lines, or any part of a ROADWAY distinctly marked for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings.
A motor vehicle used to transport children to or from school or a school-related activity, marked and equipped with visual signals (flashing red lights and stop arm).
A fire department, police, ambulance or other vehicle designated by law as an emergency vehicle.
A stationary authorized emergency vehicle, tow truck, TxDOT vehicle, or other vehicle listed in Texas Transportation Code §545.157 that is using visual signals (flashing lights).
A person riding a bicycle on the road, who is the operator of a vehicle under Texas law.
A dashed yellow center line separating opposing traffic that permits passing when safe.
A continuous yellow center line separating opposing traffic that marks a no-passing restriction for traffic on the side of the line nearest to it.
The blind-spot areas around a large truck or bus where the driver of that vehicle cannot see other vehicles.

rules.title: Pass on the left at a safe distance
rules.when: passing another vehicle going in the same direction
rules.action: pass to the left of the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE at a safe distance
rules.unless: passing on the right is permitted
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle going in the same direction, the PASSER MUST pass to the left of the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE at a safe distance, UNLESS passing on the right is permitted.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.053(a).

rules.title: Do not cut back in too soon
rules.when: passing another vehicle on the left
rules.action: move back to the right until safely clear of the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle on the left, the PASSER MUST NOT move back to the right until safely clear of the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.053(a).

rules.title: Signal the lane change
rules.when: changing lanes to pass or to return after passing
rules.action: use a turn signal to indicate the intention to change lanes
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to pass or to return after passing, the PASSER MUST use a turn signal to indicate the intention to change lanes.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.104(a) requires a signal for a lane change; the 100-foot continuous signal distance in §545.104(b) applies to turns.

rules.title: Leave a lane only when safe
rules.when: on a ROADWAY divided into two or more clearly marked lanes AND intending to pass
rules.action: move from the lane being driven in
rules.unless: the movement can be made safely
rules.statement: WHEN on a ROADWAY divided into two or more clearly marked lanes AND intending to pass, the DRIVER MUST NOT move from the lane being driven in, UNLESS the movement can be made safely.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or check procedure given

rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.060(a).

rules.title: Slower traffic keep right
rules.when: moving more slowly than the normal speed of other vehicles at the time and place under the existing conditions
rules.action: drive in the right-hand lane available for vehicles, or as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: passing another vehicle OR preparing for a left turn at an INTERSECTION or into a private road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN moving more slowly than the normal speed of other vehicles at the time and place under the existing conditions, the DRIVER MUST drive in the right-hand lane available for vehicles, or as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY, UNLESS passing another vehicle OR preparing for a left turn at an INTERSECTION or into a private road or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.051(b).

rules.title: Stay within the speed limit while passing
rules.when: passing another vehicle
rules.action: exceed the posted or statutory speed limit
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT exceed the posted or statutory speed limit.
rules.note: Texas has no exception to speed limits for passing (Transportation Code §545.351-.352); the handbook also tells drivers not to speed up beyond the limit to pass. Exact handbook wording uncertain.

rules.title: Clear view and room before using the opposing side
rules.when: on a two-way ROADWAY
rules.action: drive to the left side of the center of the ROADWAY to pass
rules.unless: the left side is clearly visible AND free of approaching traffic for a distance sufficient to permit the PASS to be made without interfering with the safe operation of any approaching vehicle or the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-way ROADWAY, the PASSER MUST NOT drive to the left side of the center of the ROADWAY to pass, UNLESS the left side is clearly visible AND free of approaching traffic for a distance sufficient to permit the PASS to be made without interfering with the safe operation of any approaching vehicle or the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.054(a).

rules.title: Return before 200 feet of oncoming vehicle
rules.when: the PASS uses a lane authorized for vehicles approaching from the opposite direction
rules.action: return to an authorized lane of travel as soon as practicable and before coming within 200 feet of an approaching vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the PASS uses a lane authorized for vehicles approaching from the opposite direction, the PASSER MUST return to an authorized lane of travel as soon as practicable and before coming within 200 feet of an approaching vehicle.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.054(b).

rules.title: Check mirrors and blind spot before passing
rules.when: about to move out to pass
rules.action: check the mirrors and look over the shoulder for vehicles in the blind spot or about to pass
rules.statement: WHEN about to move out to pass, the PASSER MUST check the mirrors and look over the shoulder for vehicles in the blind spot or about to pass.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook passing procedure; exact wording may differ.

rules.title: Return when overtaken vehicle seen in mirror
rules.when: completing a PASS
rules.action: return to the right lane only when the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE can be seen in the inside rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN completing a PASS, the PASSER SHOULD return to the right lane only when the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE can be seen in the inside rearview mirror.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook advice; exact wording uncertain.

rules.title: Four-lane two-way roads: stay right of center
rules.when: on a ROADWAY with four or more lanes for moving vehicles that provides for two-way movement
rules.action: drive left of the center line of the ROADWAY, including to pass
rules.unless: an official traffic-control device designates a lane left of center for that vehicle OR an obstruction makes it necessary to drive left of center and the DRIVER yields the right-of-way OR crossing the center line to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN on a ROADWAY with four or more lanes for moving vehicles that provides for two-way movement, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive left of the center line of the ROADWAY, including to pass, UNLESS an official traffic-control device designates a lane left of center for that vehicle OR an obstruction makes it necessary to drive left of center and the DRIVER yields the right-of-way OR crossing the center line to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.051(c).

rules.title: No left-of-center near hill crests or curves
rules.when: approaching the crest of a grade or a curve in the highway where the DRIVER's view is obstructed for a distance that creates a hazard if another vehicle approaches from the opposite direction
rules.action: drive to the left side of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a grade or a curve in the highway where the DRIVER's view is obstructed for a distance that creates a hazard if another vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left side of the ROADWAY, UNLESS on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.

vague_terms.term: a distance that creates a hazard

rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.056; exact subsection numbering and exception list should be checked.

rules.title: No left-of-center near intersections or rail crossings in cities
rules.when: approaching within 100 feet of or traversing an INTERSECTION or railroad grade crossing in a MUNICIPALITY
rules.action: drive to the left side of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN approaching within 100 feet of or traversing an INTERSECTION or railroad grade crossing in a MUNICIPALITY, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left side of the ROADWAY, UNLESS on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.056.

rules.title: No left-of-center near marked intersections or rail crossings outside cities
rules.when: outside a MUNICIPALITY AND approaching within 100 feet of or traversing an INTERSECTION or railroad grade crossing that is shown by a sign or marking
rules.action: drive to the left side of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN outside a MUNICIPALITY AND approaching within 100 feet of or traversing an INTERSECTION or railroad grade crossing that is shown by a sign or marking, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left side of the ROADWAY, UNLESS on a one-way ROADWAY OR turning left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.056; outside municipalities the restriction applies where the intersection or crossing is indicated by an official sign or marking.

rules.title: No left-of-center near bridges, viaducts, tunnels
rules.when: approaching within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel
rules.action: drive to the left side of the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN approaching within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left side of the ROADWAY, UNLESS on a one-way ROADWAY.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.056; some versions limit this to where the view is obstructed—check current text.

rules.title: Obey no-passing zones
rules.when: in a NO-PASSING ZONE that is marked by a sign or marking clearly visible to an ordinarily observant person
rules.action: drive on the left side of the ROADWAY or on the left side of any pavement striping designed to mark the NO-PASSING ZONE
rules.unless: crossing the striping or center line to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN in a NO-PASSING ZONE that is marked by a sign or marking clearly visible to an ordinarily observant person, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the ROADWAY or on the left side of any pavement striping designed to mark the NO-PASSING ZONE, UNLESS crossing the striping or center line to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.055.

rules.title: No passing in the center two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: there is a center lane marked for two-way left turns
rules.action: use the center left-turn lane to pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a center lane marked for two-way left turns, the PASSER MUST NOT use the center left-turn lane to pass.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook states the shared center lane is for left turns only; may also be enforced as disobeying a traffic-control device. Whether it is law or handbook instruction is uncertain.

rules.title: Solid yellow line on your side: no passing
rules.when: there is a SOLID YELLOW LINE on the PASSER's side of the center line
rules.action: cross the center line to pass
rules.unless: turning left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID YELLOW LINE on the PASSER's side of the center line, the PASSER MUST NOT cross the center line to pass, UNLESS turning left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook pavement markings; legal basis §545.055.

rules.title: Double solid yellow: no passing either direction
rules.when: the center line is a double SOLID YELLOW LINE
rules.action: cross the center line to pass, in either direction of travel
rules.unless: turning left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN the center line is a double SOLID YELLOW LINE, the PASSER MUST NOT cross the center line to pass, in either direction of travel, UNLESS turning left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook pavement markings; legal basis §545.055.

rules.title: Broken yellow line: passing allowed when safe
rules.when: there is a BROKEN YELLOW LINE on the PASSER's side of the center line AND the left side is clearly visible and free of approaching traffic for a distance sufficient to complete the PASS
rules.action: cross the center line to pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN YELLOW LINE on the PASSER's side of the center line AND the left side is clearly visible and free of approaching traffic for a distance sufficient to complete the PASS, the PASSER MAY cross the center line to pass.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook; the location limits in group LOC still apply.

rules.title: No-passing zone sign
rules.when: a DO NOT PASS sign or a yellow pennant-shaped NO PASSING ZONE sign marks the start of a NO-PASSING ZONE
rules.action: pass on the left side of the ROADWAY until the end of the NO-PASSING ZONE
rules.statement: WHEN a DO NOT PASS sign or a yellow pennant-shaped NO PASSING ZONE sign marks the start of a NO-PASSING ZONE, the PASSER MUST NOT pass on the left side of the ROADWAY until the end of the NO-PASSING ZONE.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.055 and Texas Driver Handbook signs section. The pennant sign is placed on the left side of the road.

rules.title: Solid white lane line discourages lane change
rules.when: lanes of traffic in the same direction are separated by a solid white line
rules.action: cross the line to change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN lanes of traffic in the same direction are separated by a solid white line, the PASSER SHOULD NOT cross the line to change lanes to pass.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook describes solid white lines as discouraging lane changes; double solid white lines prohibit crossing.

rules.title: Left lane for passing only sign
rules.when: a LEFT LANE FOR PASSING ONLY sign is posted
rules.action: drive in the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN a LEFT LANE FOR PASSING ONLY sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive in the left lane, UNLESS passing another vehicle.
rules.note: Enforced as an official traffic-control device (Transportation Code §544.004); commonly posted on Texas multilane highways.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: conditions permit safely passing on the right AND (the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE is making or about to make a left turn OR the highway has unobstructed pavement not occupied by parked vehicles and of sufficient width for two or more lines of moving vehicles in each direction OR the ROADWAY is one-way and free from obstructions and wide enough for two or more lines of moving vehicles)
rules.action: pass to the right of another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN conditions permit safely passing on the right AND (the OVERTAKEN VEHICLE is making or about to make a left turn OR the highway has unobstructed pavement not occupied by parked vehicles and of sufficient width for two or more lines of moving vehicles in each direction OR the ROADWAY is one-way and free from obstructions and wide enough for two or more lines of moving vehicles), the PASSER MAY ONLY pass to the right of another vehicle.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.057(a). Read as: passing on the right is allowed only under these conditions.

rules.title: No passing on the right off the pavement
rules.when: passing another vehicle on the right
rules.action: leave the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION of the highway to do so
rules.unless: driving on an IMPROVED SHOULDER is allowed under §545.058
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle on the right, the PASSER MUST NOT leave the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION of the highway to do so, UNLESS driving on an IMPROVED SHOULDER is allowed under §545.058.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.057(b).

rules.title: Passing on an improved shoulder
rules.when: driving on the IMPROVED SHOULDER is necessary AND can be done safely AND the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION, is disabled, or is preparing to make a left turn
rules.action: drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION to pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving on the IMPROVED SHOULDER is necessary AND can be done safely AND the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION, is disabled, or is preparing to make a left turn, the PASSER MAY ONLY drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION to pass.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.058(a); other permitted shoulder uses (stopping, accelerating, decelerating for a right turn, avoiding a collision, as directed by a traffic-control device) are outside this topic.

rules.title: Stop for a school bus with signals on
rules.when: approaching from either direction a SCHOOL BUS stopped on the highway to receive or discharge a student AND the SCHOOL BUS is operating its flashing red visual signal
rules.action: stop before reaching the SCHOOL BUS and not proceed until the SCHOOL BUS resumes motion, the SCHOOL BUS driver signals the DRIVER to proceed, or the visual signal is no longer actuated
rules.unless: the SCHOOL BUS is on a different ROADWAY of a highway with separate ROADWAYs OR the DRIVER is on a controlled-access highway and the SCHOOL BUS is stopped in a loading zone that is part of or adjacent to the highway where pedestrians are not permitted to cross
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from either direction a SCHOOL BUS stopped on the highway to receive or discharge a student AND the SCHOOL BUS is operating its flashing red visual signal, the DRIVER MUST stop before reaching the SCHOOL BUS and not proceed until the SCHOOL BUS resumes motion, the SCHOOL BUS driver signals the DRIVER to proceed, or the visual signal is no longer actuated, UNLESS the SCHOOL BUS is on a different ROADWAY of a highway with separate ROADWAYs OR the DRIVER is on a controlled-access highway and the SCHOOL BUS is stopped in a loading zone that is part of or adjacent to the highway where pedestrians are not permitted to cross.
rules.penalty: Fine of $500 to $1,250; second conviction within 5 years can bring license suspension of up to 6 months.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.066. Texas Driver Handbook notes that a highway is not 'separate roadways' merely because of a center turn lane or painted lines.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped for a pedestrian at a crosswalk
rules.when: approaching from the rear a vehicle that is stopped at a marked CROSSWALK or at an unmarked CROSSWALK at an INTERSECTION to permit a pedestrian to cross the ROADWAY
rules.action: overtake and pass the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from the rear a vehicle that is stopped at a marked CROSSWALK or at an unmarked CROSSWALK at an INTERSECTION to permit a pedestrian to cross the ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake and pass the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §552.003.

rules.title: Move over or slow down for stopped emergency and service vehicles
rules.when: approaching a MOVE-OVER VEHICLE that is stationary and using visual signals
rules.action: vacate the lane closest to the MOVE-OVER VEHICLE when the highway has two or more lanes traveling in the direction of the DRIVER, or slow to a speed not more than 20 miles per hour below the posted speed limit, or to 5 miles per hour when the posted speed limit is 25 miles per hour or less
rules.unless: directed otherwise by a police officer
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a MOVE-OVER VEHICLE that is stationary and using visual signals, the DRIVER MUST vacate the lane closest to the MOVE-OVER VEHICLE when the highway has two or more lanes traveling in the direction of the DRIVER, or slow to a speed not more than 20 miles per hour below the posted speed limit, or to 5 miles per hour when the posted speed limit is 25 miles per hour or less, UNLESS directed otherwise by a police officer.
rules.penalty: Fine up to $200; higher penalties if property damage or bodily injury results.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.157 ('Move Over/Slow Down'). The list of covered vehicles (police, fire, EMS, tow trucks, TxDOT, utility and other vehicles) has been expanded by recent legislatures; check current text.

rules.title: Passing a bicyclist at a safe distance
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST traveling in the same direction
rules.action: pass to the left at a safe distance and not move back to the right until safely clear of the BICYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST traveling in the same direction, the PASSER MUST pass to the left at a safe distance and not move back to the right until safely clear of the BICYCLIST.
rules.note: A bicycle is a vehicle under Texas law, so §545.053 applies. Texas has no statewide fixed passing distance for bicyclists; some cities (e.g., Austin, San Antonio, Houston) have vulnerable road user ordinances requiring 3 feet (6 feet for commercial vehicles).

rules.title: Passing large trucks: avoid the No-Zone
rules.when: passing a large truck or bus
rules.action: linger in the NO-ZONE beside the truck or bus, or move back in front of it before the whole front of the truck or bus can be seen in the rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN passing a large truck or bus, the PASSER SHOULD NOT linger in the NO-ZONE beside the truck or bus, or move back in front of it before the whole front of the truck or bus can be seen in the rearview mirror.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook 'Sharing the Road' with trucks; exact wording uncertain.

rules.title: Give a motorcycle a full lane
rules.when: passing a motorcycle
rules.action: use the adjacent lane and leave the motorcycle the full width of its lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a motorcycle, the PASSER SHOULD use the adjacent lane and leave the motorcycle the full width of its lane.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook motorcycle-sharing advice; Texas law does not authorize lane splitting (§545.060).

rules.title: Move right on audible signal
rules.actor: DRIVER being passed on the left
rules.when: the PASSER gives an audible signal
rules.action: move to or remain to the right in favor of the PASSER
rules.unless: passing on the right is permitted
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER gives an audible signal, the DRIVER being passed on the left MUST move to or remain to the right in favor of the PASSER, UNLESS passing on the right is permitted.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.053(b).

rules.title: Do not speed up while being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing
rules.action: accelerate until completely passed by the PASSER
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing, the DRIVER being passed MUST NOT accelerate until completely passed by the PASSER.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.053(b).

rules.title: Shoulder use to let faster traffic pass
rules.when: another vehicle traveling faster is approaching from behind AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER AND driving on it is necessary AND can be done safely
rules.action: drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION to allow the faster vehicle to pass
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle traveling faster is approaching from behind AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER AND driving on it is necessary AND can be done safely, the DRIVER MAY drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the MAIN TRAVELED PORTION to allow the faster vehicle to pass.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.058(a).

rules.title: Yield to approaching emergency vehicle
rules.when: an AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE approaches using audible and visual signals
rules.action: yield the right-of-way, immediately drive to a position parallel to and as close as possible to the right-hand edge or curb of the ROADWAY clear of any INTERSECTION, and stop and remain standing until the AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed
rules.unless: otherwise directed by a police officer
rules.statement: WHEN an AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE approaches using audible and visual signals, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way, immediately drive to a position parallel to and as close as possible to the right-hand edge or curb of the ROADWAY clear of any INTERSECTION, and stop and remain standing until the AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed, UNLESS otherwise directed by a police officer.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code §545.156.

rules.title: Help the passer get back in
rules.when: another vehicle is passing AND the PASSER needs room to return to the lane
rules.action: stay in the lane and slow down if necessary to let the PASSER return safely
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing AND the PASSER needs room to return to the lane, the DRIVER being passed SHOULD stay in the lane and slow down if necessary to let the PASSER return safely.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook advice; exact wording uncertain.
